precedence: These restrictions govern this intake. Earlier source bytes and their corrections remain intact at their original homes.

corrections.not_admitted: No address-based explanation of the 47/34 split is possible.
corrections.retained_statement: Only projections onto proper coordinate subsets fail. Full coordinates express every subset; expressibility does not explain the boundary.

corrections.not_admitted: Every mu=4 result is a vacuous cardinality fact.
corrections.retained_statement: Nonmultiples of three force mu=4, but size-three sets can have mu=3 or 4. Full-level prior 1 must not be confused with minimal-level information.

corrections.not_admitted: Failure of a fixed F3^4 translation proves absence of an operator or pairing; a difference histogram cannot describe a pairing.
corrections.retained_statement: It rules out only a single nonzero translation as an involution. Other relations and permutations exist; differences can describe a variable-displacement map.

corrections.not_admitted: 35 extracted pairs and a complete 41-edge difference-40 relation are the same verified population.
corrections.retained_statement: The reported 35 and the 7+34 arithmetic need reconciliation against raw pairs. The 41-edge relation is a separately declared mathematical model, not a validated textual extraction.

corrections.not_admitted: A constructed magic array, or a failed selected alignment, settles the historical existence of a Houtian arrangement.
corrections.retained_statement: Construction proves existence of the declared array. Failed alignment only rejects its tested criterion; historical identification is open.

corrections.not_admitted: A uniquely fitting expression in one search family explains a boundary.
corrections.retained_statement: The enlarged reported family has many fits and broad coverage. Record family and selection process; do not equate expression uniqueness with explanation.

corrections.not_admitted: Lexical alignment establishes a shared manuscript lineage and proves every unmatched unit is merely a segmentation difference.
corrections.retained_statement: Alignment proposes correspondences under a declared score; unreviewed units and genealogy remain unresolved.

corrections.not_admitted: The 25th of 30 units is an extra item at the numerical center; differently typed systems can never be compared.
corrections.retained_statement: 25 is inside 30 and is not its midpoint. Any comparison needs an explicit typed mapping; none is established by shared numerals.

corrections.not_admitted: All powers of two are fixed points of octave normalization.
corrections.retained_statement: They are preimages of the value 1. Only 1 is a positive-integer fixed point.

corrections.not_admitted: A row/column incidence total of 54 is more mixed on both axes than the canonical (9,81).
corrections.retained_statement: The block pair (27,27) increases one coordinate incidence and decreases the other. A total alone loses this directional distinction.

corrections.not_admitted: Shared vertices by themselves prove pair statistics are strongly dependent.
corrections.retained_statement: Overlap prevents assuming independence without a model; it does not logically force nonzero statistical dependence under every model.

corrections.not_admitted: A shared displacement establishes that two textual boundaries have a shared mechanism or are statistically dependent.
corrections.retained_statement: It establishes only the stated arithmetic relation; cause and statistical dependence need extra evidence.

corrections.not_admitted: The sweep was independently preregistered before results.
corrections.retained_statement: Contract and evidence appeared together; it is a declared family with no prior timestamp shown.

corrections.not_admitted: Synthetic transfer or a small supervisor-labeled pilot demonstrates classical-text semantic understanding.
corrections.retained_statement: Toy correctness, pilot labels, held-out error and Unknown outcomes stay distinct. No semantic generalization established.

corrections.not_admitted: A marginal p-value or high formula coverage proves absence of all structure.
corrections.retained_statement: The reported 4735/85320 exceeds 0.05 only under its declared test; exploratory selection and unmatched nulls prevent a universal conclusion.

corrections.not_admitted: A small rank correlation proves independence; an aggregate is not a function of its components.
corrections.retained_statement: The finite table has a small descriptive coefficient only. An aggregate is a function of components but generally does not determine them.

observation_only.yi: Source reports 64 statements, 384 lines and two extras; no new collation performed.
observation_only.taixuan: Source reports 81 heads, 729 positions, 728 separable statement/commentary pairs, one unresolved position and two extras; the 47/34 naming split is transcription-specific.
observation_only.weishi: Source reports 49/138/131 passages, 23/91/90 extracted candidates and 21/23 matches on one axis. These are reported measurements, not mathematical theorems or independently replayed corpus measurements.
